classification.difficultyReason: Express the base width using the two equal folds, then form and expand a rectangular area.

content.prompt:
A rain gutter is made from a 30 cm wide strip of metal by bending up the sides at right angles.

Each side is bent up by $x$ cm.

Show that the cross-sectional area $A$ of the gutter is $A=30x-2x^2$.

spec.description: Unlabelled open gutter extending diagonally upwards to the right. The near cross-section is a U; a dashed longitudinal edge lies behind the left wall. Outline-only house rendering omits non-mathematical grey face shading. Far ends remain open.
spec.mathematics: Two equal sides are bent perpendicular to a rectangular base; the strip width is shared between the base and both sides. Perspective coordinates are illustrative and supply no additional measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: Question figure contains no supplied answer or dimension labels.

answer.worked:
Base width: $30-2x$ cm, since both sides are bent up.

Height: $x$ cm.

$$\begin{align*}A&=x(30-2x)\\A&=30x-2x^2\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
